assetSpec.format: PNG source; JPEG q85 only at ingestion

chainRules: t02-t09 use the previous frame right edge as the sole structural reference
t10 right edge is naturally dark/simplified; no half-floating structure
chain heads and tails do not touch each other in the runtime
no CSS/Phaser-drawn scenery and no transparent fog-only seam cover
resource images may be produced as intermediate inputs, but each delivered chain frame is flattened into one opaque scene

style.palette: cold blue/teal fog night, deep blue silhouettes, sparse warm lanterns

roundWorkflow: Produce one chain frame, validate its right-edge continuation contract, seek art review, then use it as the next frame reference.
